description: The pie chart is designed to represent the distribution of different categories related to the Nondeterministic Polynomial-time Problem Challenge An Ever-Scaling Reasoning Benchmark for LLMs. There are five slices in the chart, each representing a different category. The categories are Uncrushable, Complexity, Instance, Coverage, and General. The Uncrushable slice is yellow and occupies approximately 20% of the chart. The Complexity slice is orange and takes up about 25% of the chart. The Instance slice is blue and represents roughly 15% of the chart. The Coverage slice is green and accounts for about 20% of the chart. The General slice is red and makes up the remaining 20% of the chart. The chart does not include a legend, percentage labels inside the slices, or any visual emphasis on specific slices. The segments are ordered in a way that the largest slice is Complexity, followed by Uncrushable, Coverage, General, and Instance.
